title: Theoretical Studies on the Potential Energy Surfaces of N8 Clusters
authors: Qian Shu Li, Li Jie Wang

species.method: B3LYP/6-311+G* (paper's preferred level; also B3LYP/BPW91/BLYP/B3PW91 at 6-31G*)

bond_params.shape: open-chain N8 -- reactant/intermediate for the N8(Cs) -> N5+ + N3- decomposition and N8(Cs) -> N8(C2h) isomerization studied in this paper. Full bond lengths annotated in Fig. 1 (top-right panel) at 5 levels of theory, not transcribed here (multi-level stacked figure numbers, risk of bond-index misattribution) -- re-read Fig. 1 directly if precise values needed.

species.suggested_build: chain (geom.py chain2d) -- likely, pending figure confirmation
species.notes: POSSIBLE DUPLICATE: likely overlaps with an existing open-chain N8 conformer already in biblio_polyN/build/molecules.py (e.g. N8_C2h_ladder, N8_C2h_EEE/ZEZ, N8_Cs_ZEE) -- flag for careful graph-isomorphism check during central dedup rather than assuming new. Genuine local minimum (used as PES stationary point, all-real frequencies implied by its role as reactant).

species.source_note: Fig. 1 (labeled N8(C2h)), prose p.C (isomerization section), Table 1 energy = -437.902168 au

bond_params.shape: open-chain, C2h; one bond type between single/double (1.394 A), other near N2H2 double-bond length (1.252 A)

species.notes: POSSIBLE DUPLICATE: likely overlaps with an existing N8_C2h_* entry in molecules.py (chain conformer with double-bond alternation) -- flag for graph-isomorphism dedup check. Slightly more stable than N8(Cs) (isomerization barrier 4.0-5.4 kcal/mol from Cs to C2h, QCISD/B3LYP level). Genuine local minimum (product of the isomerization PES study).

not_extracted_but_relevant: Paper's main content is PES/kinetics (barrier heights for N8(Cs)->N5++N3- decomposition: 23.4 kcal/mol forward, 2.0 kcal/mol reverse; N8(Cs)->N8(C2h) isomerization barrier 4.0-5.4 kcal/mol) plus VTST rate constants -- same category as N7d.pdf's decomposition-pathway data, relevant to future kinetic-stability work (see rapport_polyN_biblio.tex roadmap) but not new stable-isomer structures beyond the two N8 entries above. The Complex(Cs), TS(Cs), and TS1(C1) species in Fig. 1 are transition states / van der Waals complexes, not stable isomers -- not extracted as species entries.
